info.name: Student Management System API Testing
info.description: Attendance API tests for the existing Spring Boot application. Run requests in order. Student and subject IDs must already exist.

variable.value: This remark intentionally exceeds the configured maximum length and verifies validation behavior from Postman.

item.name: 01 Create Attendance
item.description: Creates the record used by subsequent requests. The collection pre-request script changes a configured future date to today because the backend prohibits future attendance dates.

exec: pm.test('Response is valid attendance JSON', () => { pm.expect(data.id).to.exist; pm.expect(data.studentId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('studentId'))); pm.expect(data.subjectId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('subjectId'))); });
pm.test('Remarks are updated', () => pm.expect(data.remarks).to.eql('Updated by Postman'));
pm.test('Status is 201 or duplicate is documented', () => pm.expect([201,409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Status code is 400 or duplicate is reported', () => pm.expect([400,409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
